strings.name: Marcel Herrmann Telles
strings.role: Co-founder of 3G Capital; former CEO of Brahma
strings.summary: Marcel Herrmann Telles is a Brazilian entrepreneur and investor who worked at Garantia, later led Brahma and invested in consumer businesses with longstanding partners. He co-founded 3G Capital and has supported education initiatives. His career spans brewing consolidation, family succession in ownership and shareholder governance disputes concerning Americanas.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Distinguishes companies and individuals, current and former offices, share gifts and board terms, and shareholder statements and judicial findings; event announcements are not attendance records.
strings.influence.rationale: Participated in Brazilian brewing consolidation and 3G investments, advancing global operations of major consumer companies.
strings.facts.f1.label: Management experience
strings.facts.f1.value: A 2012 prospectus records his service as Brahma CEO from 1989 to 1999.
strings.facts.f2.label: Directorship and ownership
strings.facts.f2.value: His AB InBev board mandate ended on June 3, 2020; a separate 2023 disclosure concerned a gift of related interests to his son Max. These were distinct events.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Longstanding investment partnership
strings.highlights.h1.text: Worked with Jorge Paulo Lemann and Carlos Alberto Sicupira; 3G's website identifies Alex Behring and Daniel Schwartz as its current co-managing partners. Being a founder does not mean running daily operations.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Education support and governance disputes
strings.highlights.h2.text: Founded Ismart to support educational opportunities for low-income students; in the Americanas investigations, shareholders issued a defense and cooperation statement through LTS, which is not a court ruling.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Responds to Americanas investigation through LTS
strings.timeline.t1.text: Media reported that three major shareholders promised cooperation and said former management had misled them; this was the shareholders' position.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Gifts related control interests to his son
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company disclosed that Max replaced his father as one of BRC's joint ultimate controllers; the announcement was published on December 28.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Ends AB InBev board mandate
strings.timeline.t3.text: The 2020 annual report explicitly records the end of his mandate on the annual shareholders' meeting date.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Joins Burger King-related boards
strings.timeline.t4.text: The 2012 prospectus lists him as a director of Worldwide and Holdings from this month.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Helps establish 3G Capital
strings.timeline.t5.text: The investment firm developed from the longstanding partners' investment office.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founds Ismart
strings.timeline.t6.text: Established an education support organization focused on learning and development opportunities for low-income young people.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Begins leading Brahma
strings.timeline.t7.text: Became CEO of the brewing company, serving until 1999.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Garantia
strings.timeline.t8.text: Entered the financial institution in an early stage of his investing and management career.
